resources.string: Can\'t play this link here, so it opens in the browser.
Open ViktorychTV, go to Settings > TV and press \"Use my feed for the screensaver\" to see photos from your feed here.

YouTube, X, Twitch and video or music links open in ViktorychTV Player: red progress bar, round buttons and the post\'s text on top. OK plays or pauses, left and right jump 10 seconds. Other apps keep working as before.
Pick ViktorychTV Player and choose Always when a link opens
Photos and short muted clips from your feed with the post text and a clock. Send them from the site: Settings > TV > Use my feed for the screensaver. They stay on this TV.
Pick ViktorychTV feed in the TV\'s screensaver settings
On Google TV: Settings > System > Ambient mode > Screensaver. On other TVs: Settings > Device Preferences > Screen saver. Pick ViktorychTV feed.
